title: ZSTX-15 Fire Spinkler Head
description:
ZSTX-15 Fire Spinkler Head
SC ZSTX-15 68℃ Pendent Fire Extinguishing System Protection Fire Sprinkler Head HS
Features:

Fire sprinkler is a key component part of automatic fire extinguishing system .It aims to detect fire and control or extinguish the fire through sprinkler.

1.Sprinklers assembled from copper alloy frame, glass balls and seals with compact shape and delicate appearance.

2.High strength and corrosion resistance, surface passivation Original color or polished chrome, to choose from.

3.Widely used in restaurants, hotels, shops, commercial buildings, storage warehouse, underground garage, garment factories.

4.Dimension:5.4x3cm

5.Type:Pendent sprinklers

6.Action temperature: 68 Degree

Package included:

1 x Fire sprinkler
